title: Self-Improving Long-Horizon Reasoning by Learning Summaries from Local Continuations
abstract: arXiv:2611.31621v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reasoning models degrade as their context grows, so longer reasoning traces do not by themselves give longer effective horizons. One way to extend the horizon is to compress the reasoning history into a compact state from time to time and continue from the state. Existing methods train the state with the final-answer reward or distill it from a stronger model. Neither signal is tailored to measure the contribution of the state alone. We observe that a reasoning model that degrades over long trajectories still behaves reliably in short contexts. We aim to preserve this short-context behavior when compressing the reasoning history. Motivated by this, we train a separate summarizer with Delta-KL, a reward computed from the frozen reasoning model's token-level predictions on sampled continuations, and run inference by truncating the trace, summarizing it, and continuing from the summary (TruSuCo). translated_title: 通过从局部续写中学习摘要实现自我提升的长程推理
translated_abstract: 推理模型会随着上下文的增长而性能退化，因此更长的推理轨迹本身并不能带来更长的有效推理范围。扩展推理范围的一种方法是定期将推理历史压缩成一个紧凑的状态，并从该状态继续推理。现有方法使用最终答案奖励来训练该状态，或从更强的模型中蒸馏得到，这两种信号都无法专门衡量状态本身的贡献。我们观察到，在长轨迹上性能退化的推理模型在短上下文中仍然表现可靠，我们的目标是在压缩推理历史时保留这种短上下文行为。受此启发，我们使用Delta-KL训练一个独立的摘要器——Delta-KL是一种由冻结的推理模型对采样续写的token级预测计算得到的奖励——并通过截断轨迹、生成摘要、再从摘要继续的方式进行推理（TruSuCo）。训练仅使用几千个问题……
tldr: 提出TruSuCo方法，通过Delta-KL奖励训练独立摘要器将长推理历史压缩为紧凑状态，利用模型自身在短上下文中的可靠表现实现长程推理能力的自我提升，而无需最终答案奖励或更强模型的蒸馏。
en_tdlr: TruSuCo trains a separate summarizer with a Delta-KL reward derived from the frozen reasoning model's own token-level predictions, compressing long reasoning histories into compact states to achieve self-improving long-horizon reasoning without final-answer rewards or distillation from stronger models.
